library(ggplot2)
data <- iris
data <- c(49,-10,27,13,36,19,48,21,8,16,32,28,-13,31,2,19,19,35,-8,23,13,8,41,12)
#sensitive to extreme values
mean(data)
# not effected by values NA for median
median(data)
hist(data)
#data[1] <- NA
#data
#mean(data, na.rm= T) 
#mean wont work with NA values, so we have to remove them

#median(data, na.rm= T)
summary(data)
IQR(data)
var(data)
sqrt(var(data))

#----------------------------
# Jan 29
#----------------------------
library(ggplot2)
data <- mpg
# data$<variable name>
hist(data$cty)
# data, <datasetname>
ggplot(data, aes(x = cty)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "blue", color = "black", binwidth = 3)
median(data$cty)
IQR(data$cty)
boxplot(data$cty)
ggplot(data, aes(y = cty)) +
  boxplot()
table(data$trans)
barplot(table(data$trans))
ggplot(data, aes(x = trans)) +
  geom_bar()
  
plot(data$cty, data$hwy)
ggplot(data, aes(x = cty, y = hwy)) +
  geom_point()
# 
data
boxplot(data$cty ~ data$drv)
ggplot(data, aes(x = drv, y = hwy)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
  
table(data$year)
barplot(table(data$year, data$drv))
#ggplot(data, aes(x = [year, fill = drv])) +  geom_bar()
ggplot(data, aes(x = as.factor(year), fill = drv)) + geom_bar()
